description: Token Accounts (Batch). Calls only POST /v4/wallets/batch/token-accounts-balance-ts. The request body lists wallets to read. This tool does not create, modify, or delete data. Solana API endpoint for fetching multi-wallet token account history with raw balance snapshots for custom analytics and unaggregated time-series data.

body.description: Response payload model for account time series raw params many results returned by this API endpoint.

days.description: Number of previous days to include in the data (from today's date), up to 30 days (default 14).

limit.description: Limit of entries to return (per day). If not passed, first 1000 entries are returned (the maximum).

ownerAddresses.description: Wallets to include in the returned results (max 10).

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending based on 'amount', 'amountScaled', 'priceUsd', 'valueUsd', or 'mintAddress'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending based on 'amount', 'amountScaled', 'priceUsd', 'valueUsd', or 'mintAddress'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

vybeTokenFilter.description: Whether Vybe's token filter should restrict the tokens that are returned. If false, all priced tokens are included. Default is true.

name: get-token-accounts-batch
title: Token Accounts (Batch)
